application_sentences: The Clarius Software that is integrated into the 4200A-SCS includes a project for testing bioFETs.
The 4200A-SCS comes with support and ready-to-run tests for the latest in NVRAM technologies from floating gate flash to ReRAM and FeRAM.
These SMUs are ideal for connecting to LCD test stations, probers, switch matrices or any other large or complicated tester.
